The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on July 30, 2025, reconstituted the Audit Committee, Nomination & Remuneration Committee, and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Committee. Pursuant to the said reconstitution, Mr. Subramanyan S. K was appointed as the Chairman of the aforesaid Committees with effect from August 28, 2025, and Mr. Dilip Dinkar Kulkarni ceased to be the Chairman of the said Committees with effect from August 27, 2025.
Further, Mr. Wu Xiaohui ceased to be a member of the CSR Committee with effect from July 30, 2025, and Mr. Sun Yajie was appointed as a member of the CSR Committee with effect from July 31, 2025.
